people.name: Victor B. Lieberman
people.field: history of early modern Southeast Asia and Eurasia

relations.subject: Victor B. Lieberman
relations.role: Raoul Wallenberg Distinguished University Professor of History and Professor of Asian and Comparative History
relations.evidence: He presently serves as the Raoul Wallenberg Distinguished University Professor of History and Professor of Asian and Comparative History at the University of Michigan, where he began teaching in 1984.

relations.subject: Victor B. Lieberman
relations.evidence: Lieberman graduated first in his class and summa cum laude from Yale University in 1967, and was the recipient of the Warren Memorial High Scholarship Prize as the highest ranking Bachelor of the Arts candidate.

relations.subject: Victor B. Lieberman
relations.object: School of Oriental and African Studies, University of London
relations.evidence: He obtained a PhD in Southeast Asian history from the School of Oriental and African Studies, University of London in 1976.
